_about: The CTs on a site an exec's entry meets (Entry.cs), where he wants them (20/10, his 17:53 video: "je ne veux personne en bas ... je veux que les joueurs soient vraiment sur l'espace de bombsite", each spot marked with an HE dropped at his feet): what covers them ('by': the grenade of the exec meant for it, 'molotov': "l'idée c'est qu'il brûle"), crouched or not. Each one put on the base's nearest CT spot of a take within 80 u ('fixed': kept where it is), the base's most met ones he did not mark added (train.take_spots).
